reason: Refuted as written. The core idea is sound: exp78b (cap 12 fc2) plus a cap-24 fc2 rung in W1, with exp76e and thr 0.2 dropped. That fits the user's aggressive-mode lift and the 19:10:58Z 'pick finals after all variants'. Runtime is ~0 (verified: tools/build_probe_kernel.py DIVINS_CALL scores every candidate triple before cap/thr/fc). Probe 46 (56611472) is still PENDING at the 20:25:10Z header, so it can still be logged in time. The defects are in the conditional branching, which is the substance of the finding. (1) The 46 >= 0.957 row reads noise. Forkmid alone is +5-9e-5 public (CONTEXT l.3191), so it crosses a 3-dp boundary with P ~0.05-0.09. That is the MC's own P(46 = 0.957) = 0.08. The thr-0.3 extras are ~0.6 evaluable public events. So a 0.957 says almost nothing about thr 0.3, yet the row moves BOTH DIV slots onto thr-0.3 bases (exp73m, and exp80b, which is unbuilt). Only >= 0.958 (P 0.11) would need a thr-0.3 TP. Lab q(0.3) ~0.12 is below the public break-even of 0.22-0.27, so the extra events have a negative expected value on private. The switch also re-opens the I-310 'threshold neighbour' ban (l.2673/2967). The MC gap it relies on (I3 0.75-0.86 vs exp78b ~0.70 given 46 >= 0.957) is within model noise and conditioned on the same single read. (2) It is not reconciled with the same round's PC20-01/PC20-02. PC20-02 proposes W1 v3 = 79a CI, 78a, 79d SEC, 78b with a slot held. R20ID-4 gives 2 of 3 W1 slots to DIV and leaves only one of CI/SEC, which pushes the other lever's read into W2 and breaks the v2 (5) max-stack logic. Its 00:05Z exp78b also collides with v2 (4) CI-at-00:05Z and the >= 40 min spacing rule. Without PC20-01's own-base coding, the W2 rules (R20ID-5) would code a 0.955 as MASKED instead of NEG. (3) Private value of the volume direction is weak. Cap 12-24 extras are low-score candidates: in-sample lab evaluable precision is 0.08 in the 0.40-0.45 band and 0.17 in 0.45-0.50, against break-even 0.22-0.27, and out of sample it should be lower. 44b6 is -0.0008 vs K2 at every cap >= 6. The +0.002 public cap-6 read that drives the MC is ~1 event on one embryo, and the lab sign was wrong twice. This is acceptable only because #37 remains the nested anchor; the files are a public-display chase, not a private gain. (4) exp80a/exp80b do not exist yet (no experiments/exp80*). exp73m is built (cap 12, fc 2, thr 0.3, forkmid on) but has no dummy.

The only 46-dependent change: if 46 codes NEG vs its own base (<= 0.955), or <= 0.954, drop cap 24 and use exp78a in its slot. No thr-0.3 base switch in any row, so do not build exp80b and do not dummy exp73m. Keep exp76e, exp73s/I4, steal-off and frame cap >= 3 dropped. CI (exp79a, pushed first per PC20-03) keeps 00:05Z. The third W1 slot goes to CI, not SEC: SEC is public-only while Q3 is open, and CI is the longest-latency lever. SEC (exp79d) takes the E10-held slot at 12:00Z or W2. Add the caveat 'higher cap = weaker candidates, lower private precision; volume picked on the public embryo' to any DIV V_pub message. The partner is always #37.
